confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on several aggregator snapshots (Expatistan, Combien-Coute citing Numbeo) dated May to July 2026, with peso prices converted at an approximate 1,450-1,500 ARS per USD taken from Expatistan's own USD figures, not an official ARS rate. Peso volatility means these may be stale by the pricing window. Cocktail is a rough estimate from one downtown-club average, adjusted down for typical bars. Wine glass is low confidence: no per-glass price was found, so it is inferred from bottle-retail prices and the beer anchor. Both accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no listings or booking pages were checked. The FX rate came from RBA daily-rate figures shown in search results for 14-16 October 2026; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Prices are Buenos Aires-specific food and drink snapshots, with accommodation set holistically against regional Latin American city levels.
